comments.content: Unused import `com.microsoft.playwright.options.WaitForSelectorState` is imported but never used. Remove it to avoid compilation warnings.

page.viewportSize() can return null if viewport is not set, causing NPE on width/height access. Guard against null or use page.viewportSize().orElse(...) before computing scrollX/scrollY. Also scrolling the page before page.mouse().move(x,y) changes the coordinate space: mouse.move expects viewport coordinates, so the click may land at the wrong location after the instant scroll.

systemPrompt column changed from nullable=false to nullable=true and defaulted to " ". This changes the semantic from null to a single space and relaxes the DB constraint. Existing code and DB schema may expect null for a deprecated field; using " " can break empty/null checks and may cause migration issues. Consider keeping null semantics or using @Column(nullable=true) with no Java default and handle deprecation explicitly.
